title: English Practice Quiz 0998
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Which answer best describes a strength in an interview?
options: I organise tasks carefully and meet deadlines.
questions.explanation: A strong answer gives a relevant skill and a practical example or result.

questions.question: She is used to ___ early for her shift.
questions.explanation: Be used to is followed by a noun or gerund.

questions.question: A 'qualification' is ___.
options: a recognised skill, certificate or achievement
questions.explanation: A qualification is evidence of education, training or ability.

questions.question: If you do not know an interview answer, you should ___.
options: admit what you know and explain how you would learn
questions.explanation: Honesty and a willingness to learn are better than inventing information.

questions.question: The candidate, as well as the referees, ___ been contacted.
questions.explanation: The main subject candidate is singular; as well as does not make it plural.

questions.question: To 'supervise' a team means to ___.
questions.explanation: Supervise means oversee work and provide guidance.

questions.question: A supervisor asks whether you can cover an extra shift. Which reply is best if you are unavailable?
options: I am sorry, I am unavailable then. I can help on Saturday.
Maybe, but I will not tell you.
questions.explanation: A clear and respectful reply states availability and offers an alternative if possible.

questions.question: I look forward to ___ from you.
questions.explanation: Look forward to is followed by a gerund.

questions.question: A 'deadline' is the ___.
options: latest time by which work must be completed
questions.explanation: A deadline is the final time or date for completing something.

questions.question: Which information should usually be left out of a professional CV unless specifically required?
questions.explanation: A CV should focus on relevant professional information and avoid unnecessary personal details.
